description:
Chesterville’s resident romance novelist, Sweetpea Rabbithole, knows how to write desire—but she’s never tasted it. Determined to change that, she sets out to find someone who can show her what she’s been missing. But when her childhood friend Edward learns of her plan, he's determined to be her first and only lesson. With a mask, a mysterious identity, and a master plan to show her he can be more than the little boy she grew up with, will these friends finally realize what was there all along?

(Source: Tapas) 

 *Note: Part of Metatoon's Sunae Danpyeonseon (순애 단편선) Collection.*
